nonBlockingObservations.title: Keep canonical equality in controls and the production invariant allocation-free
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The request and r4 change table describe equality with canonical_bytes as a control, which is consistent with the single-allocation encoder. LD-C2A-3 additionally says inequality produces an Internal refusal, which could be read as requiring a second production canonical_bytes encoding. That reading would rebuild the omitted JsonValue tree and reintroduce the allocations r4 removes. The C1a3 precedent instead checks the hand-encoded length against the prediction in production and uses canonical equality controls.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: State explicitly that canonical_bytes equality is test-only and that the production Internal guard checks allocation-free invariants such as encoded length D. Keep the counting/equality oracle outside the funded production encoder. The recorded scratch vector exercises Unicode, quote, backslash, newline and a general control; retain the planned full vector controls for the other short escapes and the exact/one-short WorkScope tests rather than treating those as already demonstrated by the scratch log.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Distinguish a sufficient old estimate from a deliberately insufficient comparison allowance
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The new merge sort needs at most n*ceil(log2 n), which never exceeds r3’s n*ceil(log2(n+1)) estimate for n >= 2. A scope funding that entire old estimate therefore need not exhaust; reverse 20 uses only 40 comparisons while the old estimate funds 100. The scratch actually limits funding to min(old_estimate, actual_comparisons-1), so it demonstrates the one-comparison-short case, not exhaustion at the full old estimate. Precharging every actual comparator call is sound regardless.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Have the full-old-estimate control succeed without any unfunded comparison, and separately require actual_comparisons-1 funding to refuse Budget before the next comparison. Correct the sentence promising Budget for either case. Define the reference comparison bound as zero for n < 2 and duplicate-pass work as n.saturating_sub(1), covering the empty-tree helper case without underflow.
